title: The Meta-RCT Approach to Measuring AI's Labor Market Impact

contributions.purpose: 首次以RCT作为技术暴露度测量的数据源
contributions.mechanism: 汇聚经济学/社科中直接测AI因果效应的RCT
contributions.evaluation: 定性(仅给职业排名表,无暴露分值)
contributions.domain: 劳动经济学/AI职业暴露度
contributions.source_quote: to the best of my knowledge, it is the first to introduce RCTs as a data source for measuring technological exposure, bringing causal identification into a literature often reliant on proxies.

contributions.mechanism: 4步:识别/摘要/相关性(1-3)/影响(0-3),E_t=R·I·w·p再聚合
contributions.evaluation: 定性;公式化聚合,权重取O*NET重要性与频率
contributions.source_quote: it develops a transparent pipeline for linking experimental findings to the O*NET task framework and aggregating them into occupational indices.

contributions.purpose: 展示RCT暴露指数产生有意义的职业差异
contributions.evaluation: 最高:物理学家/急诊医师/分子生物学家;最低:农产品分拣/洗碗工/快餐工(仅排名,无分数)
contributions.source_quote: it demonstrates that the RCT Exposure Index produces meaningful variation across occupations that both complements and challenges existing exposure measures.

self_declared_provenance.quote: This paper builds on and extends the prior approaches by introducing the RCT Exposure Index, which systematically maps treatment effects from experimental studies to O*NET tasks and then aggregates them into occupational-level exposure measures.
Our methodological approach of mapping AI benchmark performance into occupational exposure builds on two recent papers. First, Felten et al. (2021)... Second, Eloundou et al. (2024)...

notes: 破坏双盲:单作者Kris Gulati在脚注实名署名并列IHS基金号(IHS018498等)、致谢Raymond Kim,正文又引用自己的Gulati(2025)BAIOE。非实证/定性研究:结果表只给职业排名、无任何暴露分数或统计量,无法核验;evaluation按协议允许非数字。checklist AI披露:分析[A]"AI did everything"、写作[B]、假设[B]。作者自认不可复现——reproducibility[No]("keep this private to develop a whole paper later")、code[No]、实验细节[No],且明说"very preliminary...intended for this conference only"、若发展会转投(疑似占坑/转投)。数据红旗:LaTeX导言泄漏进正文("[utf8]inputenc [T1]fontenc hyperref...")。
